notes.title: Seasons of Rocco Official Release
notes.notes:
Dear Cozy Gamers,

We are thrilled to announce that Seasons of Rocco is now officially released and ready for you to immerse yourself in the heartwarming world of Rocco! Will you help Rocco prepare for the winter season? 

What to Expect: 
Explore the autumn season as you help Rocco gather and sort fruit at his Tree House. 
Plant new fruit trees in the spring to ensure a bountiful harvest for the winter ahead.

📢 Important Notice for Playtesters:
If you've been a part of our playtesting journey, we sincerely thank you! Please note that with the official release, we recommend deleting your save data to fully enjoy the polished and finalized experience. You can do this from the main menu.

How to Delete Save Data:
Navigate to the main menu.
Click on the “Reset” button.
Click on “Play” to start your new journey!

Thank you for being a part of our journey! We can't wait for you to experience the complete Seasons of Rocco adventure. 🍎🍊🍐🍋


Your support means the world to us. Are you ready to start this adventure? 

With love and full bellies,

Vivid Visions Studios 🍁❄️🌱☀️
